1.Apply at your home university
Would you like to apply for a semester abroad at DIT?
View your course options here:  
www.th-deg.de/en/study-with-us/exchange-students.
After you have chosen a study programme, contact the International
Office at your home university for further information on the
application process for a semester abroad.
2.Nomination
Your home university informs us by e-mail that you have been 
selected to spend a semester abroad at DIT. 
Application Procedure for 
Exchange Students
5.Before travelling to DIT
• Apply for student accommodation
• Non-EU students only: 
 - Apply for a student visa 
 - Get travel insurance (German public insurance which is required 
          for your studies at DIT. Can also be obtained after your arrival at DIT)
• Make a learning agreement with your home university
• Book your flight to Germany
6.On arrival 
Join our Orientation Weeks and 
make new friends from all over 
the world. 
4.Letter of acceptance
After having checked your application, we will send your official 
letter of acceptance by e-mail.
Welcome to the orientation weeks!
TICKET
www.th-deg.de/en/study-with-us/exchange-students
3.Application process 
through mobility online
Apply through our online application portal  
Mobility Online. Documents needed:
• CV
• Enrolment certificate
• Transcript of records
• Copy of passport
• Proof of English language skills
Mobility
online
